paragraphs.text: You mention the reporter’s job, which you secured at the Arkham Gazette on the strength of a few freelance pieces in your local newspaper. It will be a relief to get away from vapid society columns and whimsical stories! You understand the Gazette covers everything from the breakthroughs of researchers at Miskatonic University to the most sordid exploits of local ne’er-do-wells. It should be something to get your teeth into, at any rate.
“A writer? For a newspaper?” Silas seems confused, as if he thought the stories somehow wrote themselves.

Your Occupation Skills are: Art/Craft (Photography), History, Library Use, Own Language, Psychology and one of either Charm, Fast Talk, Intimidate, or Persuade. You may also pick any two other skills except Cthulhu Mythos as personal specialties. Allocate the following values among these Occupation Skills, writing in the large square beside each: 70%, 60%, 60%, 50%, 50%, 50%, 40%, 40%. Ignore any starting value already mentioned on the investigator sheet.
